'''Mount Ulgo''' was the name given to a mountain in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The [[Ulgo Fortress]] was built on the mountain and its slopes, and a tunnel was built through the mountain.
